note: Import kit/hub_r1_tex.fbx with Import 3D (Creator = Gunsy Funsy): each TX_ quad gets a SurfaceAppearance whose ColorMap/NormalMap/RoughnessMap/MetalnessMap asset ids are the uploaded images. Copy those ids into MaterialVariants / Texture objects per 'use', then delete the quads.

TX_concrete_smooth.use: MaterialVariant 'TacConcrete' (base Concrete) = MaterialService Concrete override; all wall mass, frames, ceilings

TX_concrete_panels.use: MaterialVariant 'TacConcretePanels' (base Concrete): wall bay plates, door-frame cheeks, cladding

TX_corrugated_metal.use: MaterialVariant 'TacCorrugatedMetal' (base Metal): tunnel cladding, crate panels, upper shell bands, catwalk kick plates

TX_corrugated_fine.use: MaterialVariant 'TacRibbed' (base Concrete): upper wall band shells and roof soffit panels (ribs from normal only)

TX_metal_floorplate.use: MaterialVariant 'TacFloorPlate' (base Metal or DiamondPlate override): centre ring plates, landing, catwalk/bridge decks, door thresholds

TX_floor_concrete.use: MaterialVariant 'TacFloorConcrete' (base Concrete, used only on floor slabs): hub floor field and borders (tinted 36-62)

TX_metal_satin.use: MaterialVariant 'TacMetal' (base Metal) = MaterialService Metal override: trims, kerbs, pilaster caps, rails, door leaves

TX_overlay_panel_lines.use: Texture (Top face), Color3 ~81 grey, Transparency 0 (0.9 as dark overlay): spawn-disc plates, pad floors, landing

TX_overlay_grid.use: Texture, all faces, Transparency 0.75, Color3 black: training range boxes (not used in the hub)

TX_grate_alpha.use: Texture (Top) on near-black host part, Color3 70-80: drain grates round the spawn disc, catwalk deck insets

TX_trim_strip.use: Texture (front faces), Color3 59-81 grey: door reveals, the 2x4 display-wall role, panel strip above the olive band

TX_grime_overlay.use: Texture, Color3 black, Transparency 0.92-0.95: lower wall kick zones and props only (never on bands or floors)

TX_hazard_stripe.use: Texture (Top/front), Color3 white: pad edges, lift edges, kerb faces at the riser, KEEP CLEAR zones (cream on near-black)

TX_lane_marking.use: Texture/Decal (Top), Color3 cream 236,232,218 at 0.2 transp.: runway lane marking along walkways into each gate (edge lines + dashes)

TX_chevron.use: Decal (Top), cream: direction chevrons toward gates

TX_louvre.use: Texture (Bottom) on Neon ceiling strips, Color3 black, Transparency 0.5
